title: CoMPAS3D: A Dataset and Benchmark for Interactive Motion
abstract: arXiv:2507.19684v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Socially interactive humanoids aim to interact with humans through their bodies, adapting in real time to a partner's movement, intent, and abilities. This requires models that understand both how bodies move and what their movements mean. Yet, existing evaluation frameworks for interactive motion generation do not assess whether generated reactive motions are valid or appropriate within a shared movement vocabulary. Existing frameworks rely on kinematic metrics such as FID and beat alignment that cannot capture this semantic property, while improvised interaction datasets lack fine-grained move annotations. Inspired by computational evaluations of games such as Go and Chess, we propose Salsa as an embodied interaction evaluation domain. translated_title: CoMPAS3D：面向交互式运动的数据集与基准
translated_abstract: 社交互动型人形机器人旨在通过身体与人类进行交互，并实时适应伙伴的运动、意图和能力。这需要模型既能理解身体如何运动，又能理解这些运动所表达的含义。然而，现有的交互式动作生成评估框架并未评估所生成的反应性动作在共享动作词汇体系中是否有效或恰当：现有框架依赖FID、节拍对齐等运动学指标，无法捕捉这一语义属性，而即兴互动数据集又缺乏细粒度的动作标注。受围棋、国际象棋等游戏计算化评估的启发，我们提出将萨尔萨舞作为一个具身交互评估领域。萨尔萨舞具有交互性和双人配对性，并受动作词汇以及社区公认的评判标准（涵盖时机、音乐性、技术、难度、配合与原创性）的约束。我们预……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将具有规范动作词汇和社区公认评判标准的萨尔萨舞作为具身交互评估领域，并构建了CoMPAS3D数据集与基准，以评估交互式动作生成中反应性动作的语义有效性与恰当性。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes Salsa as an embodied interaction evaluation domain and introduces CoMPAS3D, a dataset and benchmark that evaluates whether generated reactive motions are semantically valid and appropriate within a shared move vocabulary.
